facts.fact: The Official Gazette text of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, signed 12 June 2023, lists in its contents a Part VIII on cross-border transfers of personal data (sections 41 to 43: basis for transfer, adequacy of protection, other bases for transfer outside Nigeria); the captured text stops at the contents and gives no provision wording.

facts.fact: Premium Times reports the Commission found Meta transferred Nigerians' data abroad without authorisation under the Nigeria Data Protection Act and ordered it to stop transfers without approval.

Premium Times reports the Commission's 18 February 2025 orders against Meta, including a $32.8 million fine, cited transfer of data abroad without authorisation and directed it to halt such transfers without approval.

Nigerian Data Protection Commission's Owa says Nigeria's law applies data protection regulations to NINs wherever stored or processed, so interoperability needs regulatory equivalence or other mechanisms such as binding corporate rules in other jurisdictions.
TechCabal says the Nigeria Data Protection Commission fined MultiChoice Nigeria N766.24 million in 2025 for data protection breaches and unauthorised cross-border transfers of personal data.
